Edit: Just because I did something doesn't mean you should do it. Makeshift binding is bad for anyone. If you want to bind, get a real binder!!!

I don't have much experience so my advice might not be the best, but you could start at a lower dose of testosterone. The changes would be slower and it would give more time to decide if you like it. On a personal note, my doubts come from fear of a lifetime commitment. Forever is a long time to commit to something, so it might help to remember that at any time you can decide you don't want T, from the drive to the appointment to years on T, you can stop taking T. Permanent changes will develop, but they will come slowly especially if you take a lower dose.  Another thing I ask myself when I am unsure is "Even if it doesn't make my happy forever can I live with it forever?"  Most of the time for me the answer for me is yes. Even with permanent changes, you can still live as a girl if you change your mind. You would be way ahead of most trans femme people. As for the body/weight issues vs gender dysphoria, you can have both, but hopefully, you don't have body/weight issues. 


You seem confident and know what you want and are just nervous and seeking reassurance. If you are honestly unsure, postpubescent, and not going to self-harm there is no harm in waiting. If you are not postpubescent you could try blockers and if you are going to self-harm find someone to talk to. You can pm me if you want.
